issue.title: Navigation events are called twice when using HashLocationStrategy

**I'm submitting a ...**  (check one with "x")
```
[x] bug report => search github for a similar issue or PR before submitting
[ ] feature request
[ ] support request => Please do not submit support request here, instead see https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#question
```

**Current behavior**
When using `HashLocationStrategy` and change url manually to the one, which is protected by CanActivate guard (this returns false and fire redirect to the other page), navigation events are called twice.

**Expected behavior**
All navigation event are called once only.

**Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions**
Use the demo in http://plnkr.co/edit/4xlYD9wmetG5G0Dvjp0E?p=preview
Open window mode http://run.plnkr.co/plunks/4xlYD9wmetG5G0Dvjp0E/#/component-one
Click `Guarded Component Two` link - only one `NavigationStart `and `NavigationCancel `events logged in console.
Manually change url from `/#/component-one` to `/#/component-two` and hit enter - two pair of `NavigationStart `and `NavigationCancel` events logged in console.

**What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior?**
As the duplication of navigation event causes guards logic to be executed twice (and this may contain API calls) - it is a performance issue. Potentially, if guard resolving depends on some conditions which are true after first failed attempt - the second one will be successful, however it is not desired behavior.

**Please tell us about your environment:**
<!-- Operating system, IDE, package manager, HTTP server, ... -->

* **Angular version:** 4.1.0

* **Browser:** Chrome 57
 
* **Language:** TypeScript

- [ ] Other... Please describe:


## What is the current behavior?
<!-- Please describe the current behavior that you are modifying, or link to a relevant issue. -->

Described here: https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/37048

When using `HashLocationStrategy` and changing URL hash manually in the browser then route guard that returns new UrlTree causes redirect to the same route which is flaged as duplicate:

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/b48eabddb83900496e5e00fb98e192c6c49dff26/packages/router/src/router.ts#L1274

This navigation won't make any route change because user is basically staying on the same route (according to the description in #37048 location changes are for example `#/start`, `#/bar` (canceled because of route guard) and back to `#/start`). However, hash in the URL stays `#/bar` as changed by the user.

Issue Number: #37048

## What is the new behavior?

When navigation is canceled and the new route doesn't trigger any route change, router checks that the current location path is matching current route path and if not it'll update it.

## Does this PR introduce a breaking change?

- [ ] Yes
- [x] No


<!-- If this PR contains a breaking change, please describe the impact and migration path for existing applications below. -->


## Other information

I tried to investigate what is happening but I'm really not sure my fix is appropriate (or maybe this should be handled at a different place). All tests are passing but I believe there might be some other cases that aren't covered by `integration.spec`.

Anyway, the test I added would fail without my changes. After calling `(<any>location).simulateHashChange('/one');` location path from `location.path()` would reuturn `/one`.
